title: Snap to Grid (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Snap to Grid applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Snap to Grid (BtnSnapToGrid) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Snap To Grid toggles and restores the production snap state in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Snap To Grid command flips the add-in SnapGridManager state (measured via the production SnapToGridFeature.IsEnabled), a second invocation restores the original state, both invocations report execution, the selection and slide shapes are untouched, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
